Query.VQL: LET UploadArtifacts <= get(field='UploadArtifacts') = TRUE OR get(field='UploadArtifacts') =~ '^(Y|TRUE|YES|OK)$'

LET UserDataGlobs <= SELECT * FROM if(
    condition=format(format="%T", args=[UserDataGlobs,]) =~ "string",
    then={SELECT * FROM parse_csv(filename=UserDataGlobs, accessor='data')},
    else=UserDataGlobs)

LET AIExtensionIds <= SELECT * FROM if(
    condition=format(format="%T", args=[AIExtensionIds,]) =~ "string",
    then={SELECT * FROM parse_csv(filename=AIExtensionIds, accessor='data')},
    else=AIExtensionIds)

Query.Name: Custom.Windows.Applications.AIBrowsers/InstalledAIBrowsers
Query.VQL: SELECT OSPath, Mtime, Size FROM glob(globs=UserDataGlobs.Glob)

Query.Name: Custom.Windows.Applications.AIBrowsers/CometUpdaterLog
Query.VQL: SELECT OSPath, Mtime, Size FROM glob(globs="C:/Program Files (x86)/Perplexity/CometUpdater/updater_history.jsonl")

Query.Name: Custom.Windows.Applications.AIBrowsers/BraveLeoAIChat
Query.VQL: SELECT OSPath, Mtime, Size FROM glob(globs="C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser/User Data/*/AIChat")

Query.Name: Custom.Windows.Applications.AIBrowsers/BraveLeoMemories
Query.VQL: SELECT OSPath, parse_json(data=read_file(filename=OSPath)).brave.ai_chat.user_memories AS Memories FROM glob(globs="C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser/User Data/*/Preferences")

Query.Name: Custom.Windows.Applications.AIBrowsers/AIExtensionsInstalled
Query.VQL: SELECT OSPath, Mtime, basename(path=OSPath) AS ExtensionId, { SELECT Name FROM AIExtensionIds WHERE Id = basename(path=OSPath) } AS Extension FROM glob(globs="C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/*/Extensions/*") WHERE basename(path=OSPath) IN AIExtensionIds.Id

Query.Name: Custom.Windows.Applications.AIBrowsers/AIExtensionStores
Query.VQL: SELECT OSPath, Mtime, Size, basename(path=dirname(path=OSPath)) AS ExtensionId FROM glob(globs="C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/*/Local Extension Settings/*/*") WHERE basename(path=dirname(path=OSPath)) IN AIExtensionIds.Id

Query.Name: Custom.Windows.Applications.AIBrowsers/GeminiGlicPartition
Query.VQL: SELECT OSPath, Mtime, Size FROM glob(globs="C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/Google/Chrome/User Data/*/Storage/ext/glic/**")

LET hosts = SELECT OSPath AS RegistryValue, Data.value AS Manifest FROM glob(accessor="registry", globs=["HKEY_USERS/*/Software/Google/Chrome/NativeMessagingHosts/*/@", "HKEY_USERS/*/Software/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser/NativeMessagingHosts/*/@", "HKEY_USERS/*/Software/Microsoft/Edge/NativeMessagingHosts/*/@", "HKEY_USERS/*/Software/Perplexity/Comet/NativeMessagingHosts/*/@", "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/SOFTWARE/Google/Chrome/NativeMessagingHosts/*/@", "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE/SOFTWARE/WOW6432Node/Google/Chrome/NativeMessagingHosts/*/@"])

Query.Name: Custom.Windows.Applications.AIBrowsers/NativeMessagingHosts
Query.VQL: SELECT RegistryValue, Manifest, parse_json(data=read_file(filename=Manifest)).name AS HostName, parse_json(data=read_file(filename=Manifest)).path AS BridgeBinary, parse_json(data=read_file(filename=Manifest)).allowed_origins AS AllowedExtensions FROM hosts
LET histories = SELECT OSPath FROM glob(globs="C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/*/History")

Query.Name: Custom.Windows.Applications.AIBrowsers/HistoryFromApiVisits
Query.VQL: SELECT * FROM foreach(row=histories, query={ SELECT OSPath AS HistoryFile, timestamp(winfiletime=visit_time * 10) AS VisitTime, Url, Title, format(format="0x%08X", args=transition) AS Transition FROM sqlite(file=OSPath, query="SELECT v.visit_time, u.url AS Url, u.title AS Title, v.transition FROM visits v JOIN urls u ON u.id = v.url WHERE (v.transition & 134217728) != 0 ORDER BY v.visit_time") })

Query.Name: Custom.Windows.Applications.AIBrowsers/Uploads
Query.VQL: SELECT upload(file=OSPath) AS Upload FROM foreach(row={ SELECT OSPath FROM glob(globs=["C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/Local State", "C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/*/Preferences", "C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/*/Secure Preferences", "C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/*/History", "C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/*/Web Data", "C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/*/Sessions/*", "C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/*/AIChat", "C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/Perplexity/Comet/User Data/*/IndexedDB/https_www.perplexity.ai_0.indexeddb.leveldb/*", "C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/*/*/User Data/*/Local Extension Settings/{fcoeoabgfenejglbffodgkkbkcdhcgfn,hehggadaopoacecdllhhajmbjkdcmajg,mcjlamohcooanphmebaiigheeeoplihb,npclhjbddhklpbnacpjloidibaggcgon,mjdcklhepheaaemphcopihnmjlmjpcnh}/*", "C:/Users/*/AppData/Local/Google/Chrome/User Data/*/Storage/ext/glic/**", "C:/Program Files (x86)/Perplexity/CometUpdater/updater_history.jsonl"]) }) WHERE UploadArtifacts
